source.label: Worklogs product and customer-owned invoice contract

cohorts.title: Time and invoice lines
cohorts.purpose: Reconcile prepared billable time and expected net charges against the customer's original invoice export at its agreed line grain.

cohorts.title: Worklog coverage and correction
cohorts.purpose: Compare original worklog identities and selected attributes between complete exports; review changed and removed time entries before billing.
